# Automatos AI

> Automatos OS is the open-source engine (Apache 2.0, runs on your own machine today) and Automatos Studio is the hosted app (hosted beta opens November 2026). Scaling intelligence, not headcount — multi-agent orchestration with agents, skills, playbooks, and a marketplace to run business operations end-to-end.

Automatos Studio (hosted beta opens November 2026) is the hosted app where non-engineers design specialised AI agents, connect them to real tools (Composio, APIs, workspaces), and launch them on sequential or parallel missions. Agents keep memory and a success record, collaborate through a coordinator, and are governed by budgets, human-in-the-loop approvals, and full audit trails. Customers bring their own LLM keys (BYOK); new hosted accounts start with a one-time 500-credit trial, and included platform credits start when billing opens.

## Product

- [Platform Overview](https://studio.automatos.app/): What Automatos does, who it's for, and how the digital workforce model differs from a chatbot
- [Auto & agents](https://studio.automatos.app/auto): Tell Auto what you need; it routes the work to a team of agents and brings back the result or the question
- [Command Centre](https://studio.automatos.app/command-centre): The board, calendar, questions, activity, governance and analytics for everything agents do
- [Documents & templates](https://studio.automatos.app/documents): Invoices, letters, reports and proposals rendered from one brand kit
- [Socials](https://studio.automatos.app/socials): A posting plan that makes each post on its day and waits for approval before it publishes
- [Your store & site](https://studio.automatos.app/your-store): Connect your Shopify store with your own Admin token (the Shopify app is next), and the chat and blog widgets for any website
- [Integrations](https://studio.automatos.app/integrations): Connect the apps you already use through your own accounts
- [Marketplace](https://studio.automatos.app/marketplace): 100+ ready-made agents in the Studio marketplace, 400+ skills, 70+ plugins, 20+ Playbooks and 3 packages (Socials, Shopify Management, Shopify Development)

## Pricing

- [Plans](https://studio.automatos.app/#pricing): The local edition is free and open source, on your own keys or your Claude Code / CLI subscription. Hosted Studio opens as a beta in November with three plans: Own keys at $9 a month, Pro at $29 and Business at $99. That is beta pricing, not charged until billing opens. Own keys and Pro are the same platform: on Own keys the AI runs on your own keys and your provider bills you, while Pro includes monthly AI credits. Business adds seats, agents, video render minutes, voice and a larger credit allowance. New accounts get a one-time trial of 500 credits; a credit is one US cent of AI usage at our prices. During the beta, once the trial is used, the AI runs on your own Anthropic, OpenAI or OpenRouter key on every plan, and your provider bills you for it. Business is by invite during the beta. Included credits and top-ups start when billing opens. Enterprise is coming soon: contact us.

## Compliance

- [EU AI Act posture](https://automatos.app/eu-ai-act): EU AI Act work is in progress. Social posts wait for your approval before they publish, board work can be set to ask before it runs, and every action lands in an append-only audit log, all in the product today. The Article 50 notices and the marking of generated media are being built now.
